title: India's Junior Squad Gathers for World Championships Training Camp
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for India's top junior players to hone their skills and strategies before competing on the global stage at the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian junior badminton team, preparing them for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Organises Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course Across Two National Centers
indian_angle: This initiative by BAI aims to uplift the standard of coaching across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, concluding on September 23rd, to enhance coaching expertise.

title: Indian Junior Teams Prepare for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttlers are undergoing intensive training to represent the nation and compete for medals at the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for India's U17 and U15 junior badminton teams was held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparations for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.

title: Final Selection Trials Announced for BWF World Junior Championships Squad
indian_angle: This announcement outlines the crucial final stage for aspiring Indian junior players to earn a spot in the national squad for the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: BAI released the eligibility criteria and list of players qualified for the final selection trials to determine India's contingent for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Introduced for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This major rule change for India's junior domestic circuit will impact how young Indian players train and compete, potentially shaping future national champions.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
